about: How the tune check finds the stick inputs a rate loop can be measured on, and how it measures tracking (spec: Copter analyzers, 'Rate-loop tune'). Starting values, not yet calibrated against the fleet's logs.

excitation.about: An event is a run of samples where the axis's rate target (RATE.RDes, PDes, YDes, deg/s) is at least the threshold, runs closer than merge_s joined (the two lobes of a doublet), kept when the joined run lasts min_active_s, widened by before_s and after_s to take in the start and the settling. The thresholds sit well above the targets a steady hover makes and well below what a 40% stick input in AltHold asks for.
excitation.stick_modes_about: Modes whose sticks command lean angle or rate directly, so the rate target follows the pilot. AutoTune makes its own twitches; Loiter, PosHold and the autopilot modes shape their own targets and brake on their own.
excitation.limit_flag_about: PID Flags bit 0 (LIMIT): the controller's output is saturated and the I term's anti-windup is active, set from the motors' own limit flags (AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.cpp rate_controller_run passes _motors.limit.roll, .pitch, .yaw to AC_PID::update_all).

attitude.about: Attitude tracking error of one event (roll and pitch): the RMS of (ANG.DesRoll - ANG.Roll) over the RMS of how far the input moved the attitude target from its value when the event began, in percent, so a trim angle held in wind is not counted as the pilot's command. An event counts for it as for the rate's, with at least min_samples ANG samples and a target moved by min_move_deg RMS or more; the same number of events is needed (tracking.min_events), and the interval is the same seeded bootstrap with its own seeds. It is the tune's measure: in SITL on the Callisto X8 with soft rate gains, AutoTune (roll then pitch) took attitude error from 7.0% to 2.4% light and from 9.0% to 3.1% loaded, while the rate tracking error moved 4-10%, because AutoTune also raises the angle P (7 to 20) and the acceleration limits, and the attitude loop's corrections are part of the rate target.
sources: libraries/AP_Logger/LogStructure.h and ArduCopter/Log.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: ANG (DesRoll, Roll, DesPitch, Pitch, DesYaw, Yaw) is written every loop with LOG_BITMASK bit 0 (MASK_LOG_ATTITUDE_FAST); ATT at 10 Hz (bit 1, MASK_LOG_ATTITUDE_MED).

ArduPilot Copter docs, Roll/Pitch tuning (ardupilot_wiki copter/source/docs/tuning.rst): judge the tune 'by graphing the dataflash log's ATT message's Roll-In vs Roll and Pitch-In vs Pitch'; the actual roll 'should closely follow the Roll-In while in Stabilize or AltHold modes', and pitch the same. In 4.7 the desired attitude is ATT/ANG DesRoll and DesPitch.

ADS-33E-PRF (US Army, 2000), 3.3: the short-term, small-amplitude attitude response to the pilot's input is the primary rotorcraft handling-qualities criterion; Ivler et al., 'Toward a UAS Handling Qualities Specification' (VFS Forum 78, 2022) scale it to small multirotors and flight-test it on a hexacopter.
AC_AutoTune_Multi::save_tuning_gains at Copter-4.7.0: AutoTune saves the rate P, I and D, the angle P (stabilize) and the acceleration limit of each axis it tunes.

tracking.about: Tracking error of one event: the RMS of (target - actual) over the RMS of the target, in percent. An axis's value is the mean over its counted events, with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval over the events, seeded so every laptop gets the same interval. Below min_events counted events the value is not given: the interval would be too wide to compare flights.

sources: ArduCopter/Copter.cpp loop_rate_logging and ten_hz_logging_loop at Copter-4.7.0 (1511f27): with LOG_BITMASK bit 0 (MASK_LOG_ATTITUDE_FAST) RATE is written every loop, and PIDR, PIDP and PIDY too with bit 12 (MASK_LOG_PID); with bit 1 alone RATE is written at 10 Hz. ModeAutoTune::logs_attitude() is true, so AutoTune writes its own messages instead.
ArduCopter/rate_thread.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: with the fast rate thread, RATE and the PIDs are written at the thread's fast logging rate (up to 1 kHz) with bit 0.
libraries/AP_Logger/LogFile.cpp AP_Logger::Write_PID at 4.7.0: Flags bit 0 LIMIT (output saturated, I-term anti-windup active), bit 1 PD_SUM_LIMIT, bit 2 RESET, bit 3 I_TERM_SET.
ArduCopter/Log.cpp Log_Write_Control_Tuning at 4.7.0: CTUN.Alt is the position estimate's height above the EKF origin; heights here are taken from it relative to the moment of arming.

libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.cpp at 4.7.0: RCn_MIN 1100, RCn_TRIM 1500, RCn_MAX 1900 by default; ArduCopter/radio.cpp sets the roll and pitch dead zones to 20 and yaw's to 15 or 20. The log's own values are used; the defaults stand in only where a value is missing.

response.about: The rate loop's frequency and step responses come from every stretch that measures the rate loop alone: flown in a stick mode, at least min_height_m above take-off (the excitation rules), with no gap in the log, and away from the rate PID's saturation by saturation_pad_s either side. The loop's own target and measured rate are the rate PID's Tar (after ATC_RAT_*_FLTT) and Act. Through the attitude loop, gusts move the target as well as the rate, so both responses are read through an instrument the stick sets and gusts do not: the rate of the attitude target (ANG), which input shaping makes from the stick alone. Frequency response: Giy/Gix from Welch cross-spectra with windows of the power of two nearest rate / resolution_hz samples; each bin's random error is estimated from the instrument's coherences with the target and the rate and the number of windows (Bendat and Piersol), and the measured band runs up from low_hz to the first bin whose error is over max_error, or to high_hz. The sensitivity peak counts only when the band reaches peak_reach times its frequency and |1 - H| falls to peak_drop of it on the way; one still rising at the band's top is not measured. At least min_windows windows. Step response: an impulse response step_s long from the instrumental-variable Wiener-Hopf equations with loading times the instrument-target correlation at lag 0 on the diagonal, over blocks of block_s, taken only when the frequency response is measured past its bandwidth: a step's rise and overshoot rest on the response up to it and beyond. A stretch counts when its attitude target moves at min_instrument_rms_dps or more. Intervals: a seeded bootstrap of resamples over windows and blocks. The sensitivity peak is |1 - H| only for a controller acting on the error alone, so it is given only when an axis's feed_forward parameters are all 0.
sources: Welch, P. (1967), The use of the fast Fourier transform for the estimation of power spectra; Bendat and Piersol, Random Data, cross-spectra, ordinary coherence, and the normalized random error of a frequency response estimate, sqrt(1 - g) / (|g| sqrt(2 n)), for coherence g² = g and n averages.

Ljung, System Identification: Theory for the User (2nd ed., 1999), on identification in closed loop: the joint input-output approach to closed-loop identification, and the instrumental-variable method for data taken in closed loop, where the input is correlated with the disturbance.
Norbert Wiener (1949), the Wiener-Hopf equations for the least-squares FIR estimate of an impulse response from auto- and cross-correlations.

libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl_Logging.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: ANG (DesRoll, DesPitch, DesYaw: the attitude target) is written every loop with LOG_BITMASK bit 0. libraries/AC_PID/AC_PID.cpp update_all: PID Tar is the target after the FLTT filter, Act the measurement, and FF and D_FF add the target and its derivative to the output.

Astrom and Murray, Feedback Systems (2008), section 12.2: the sensitivity peak Ms; values of 1.2 to 2 are reasonable, and 1/Ms is the shortest distance from the loop's Nyquist curve to the critical point.

health.about: The rate loop's health on any flight that logs the rate PIDs (spec: Copter analyzers, 'Rate-loop tune'). Flying time is armed and at least the excitation rules' min_height_m above take-off. Steady hover is the fingerprint's hover windows with the tune check's stick inputs taken out. I term at its limit: |PIDx.I| at i_limit_share of ATC_RAT_*_IMAX or more; a finding at i_limit_finding_pct of flying time. Slew limiter, only with ATC_RAT_*_SMAX above 0: PIDx.Dmod under dmod_limited; a finding at slew_finding_pct. D-term noise, from PIDs logged at the tune check's rate: the share of the D term's power from low_hz up that lies above noise_band_low_hz, the band the filter analysis counts as noise; a finding at d_noise_finding_pct. Oscillation: peaks of the measured rate (RATE) from oscillation.low_hz to high_hz standing prominence_db above the spectrum around them, with at least min_amplitude_dps RMS within peak_half_width_hz, and not within motor_tolerance of a harmonic of the motors' hover frequency. Spectra: Welch at resolution_hz, at least min_windows windows. Each judgement needs min_flying_s of flying. Starting values, uncalibrated.
sources: libraries/AC_PID/AC_PID.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: the integrator is held within IMAX; update_all multiplies P and D by the slew limiter's modifier (logged as Dmod) and logs the oscillation slew rate (SRate). libraries/Filter/SlewLimiter.cpp: with SMAX 0 the modifier is always 1; otherwise it never drops below 0.1.

ATC_RAT_RLL_SMAX at 4.7.0: 'Sets an upper limit on the slew rate produced by the combined P and D gains ... This limits the amplitude of high frequency oscillations caused by an excessive gain.' Copter's default is 0, off (AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.h).
knowledge/rules/filters.json noise_band_low_hz: the same 40 Hz the filter analysis counts as noise above the control band.

autotune_offer.about: When a tune check offers AutoTune, and how it is set up: ArduPilot's tuning order puts AutoTune after the filters; the next tune check, light and loaded, grades it (procedure tune.autotune_offer). On propellers of 13 inches or more the roll and pitch rate filters (FLTT, FLTD) go to 10 Hz first; with a payload that varies, AUTOTUNE_GMBK is raised for more stability margin.
sources: ArduPilot Copter docs, AutoTune: for large copters (props of at least 13 inches) set ATC_RAT_RLL_FLTT, FLTD, ATC_RAT_PIT_FLTT and FLTD to 10 Hz; tune one axis at a time if a battery cannot finish them all (AUTOTUNE_AXES) (https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/autotune.html).

ArduPilot Copter docs, AutoTune: AUTOTUNE_GMBK (default 0.25) is the share by which the tuned P and D are reduced for stability margin; raise it for more margin. 0.35 for a payload that varies is an app starting value, uncalibrated, within its range 0 to 0.5.
rules/audit.json starting_tune: large_prop_in and large_rate_filter_hz, shared with the never-tuned starting values.
